sources.entry: Revive Adserver - Ad serving system. Formerly known as OpenX Adserver and phpAdsNew. (Source Code) GPL-2.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: Revive Adserver is an open source ad serving system that lets publishers serve ads on their sites, manage campaigns from advertisers or ad networks, and track results.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Revive Adserver as an open source ad serving tool for publishers. It lets users serve ads on their websites and manage campaigns from different advertisers and/or ad networks through a web interface. It tracks and reports on campaign success, including click-through rates. It also supports targeting rules to deliver campaigns or individual ads to specific users. The README notes it is a formerly known as OpenX Adserver and phpAdsNew project, per the awesome-selfhosted listing. Installation details are not given in the README, which points users to release packages on the project website.
use_cases: Serve banner ads on your own website
Manage advertiser campaigns and ad networks
Track ad click-through rates and campaign performance
Target ads to specific users with delivery rules
Self-host an ad server instead of using a hosted service
how_to_run: Download a release package from the Revive Adserver website (do not use the GitHub zip)
notable: Formerly known as OpenX Adserver and phpAdsNew
Targeted ad delivery rules for specific users
Optional Hosted edition available from the project
Includes GeoLite2 geographic data from MaxMind
caveats: The GitHub zip is not suitable for installation; users must use release packages from the project website
A Hosted edition is offered as a paid subscription option, per the README wording to subscribe
